listings.desc: Exceptional water view of Sykes Creek, Banana River and Port from this fully updated, light, bright, 2BR/2BA condo in Merritt Towers. Enjoy sunrises, dolphin and cruise ship activity, as well as rocket launches from your oversized screened balcony, with hurricane shutters, large storage closet, and mounted TV for evening news or Sunday sports. 2025 kitchen remodel features beautiful quartz countertops, stainless appliances and white cabinets. Both bathrooms updated in 2025 with quartz countertops new shower/tub. LVP in main rooms and on balcony; carpet in bedrooms. Tasteful and useful upgrades including California Closet system in primary closet; built in dry bar in dining room; impact sliders to balcony, and crown moldings. One covered parking space and additional outdoor parking. Amenities include two heated pools, boardwalk, tennis/pickleball courts, and car wash areas. Convenient to new hospital, restaurants, shopping, I95 and 528. Acquire a piece of paradise at a reasonable price

Wake up to stunning Sykes Creek views and enjoy waterfront living at its best in this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo at Merritt Towers. From your private balcony, watch dolphins and manatees pass by—and catch unforgettable rocket launches. Inside, this bright and inviting home features an updated kitchen and baths, newer tile and waterproof vinyl flooring, crown molding, fresh paint, and a spacious open floor plan. Merritt Towers offers resort-style amenities including two pools, hot tub, sauna, tennis courts, clubhouses, and beautifully maintained grounds. Ideally located near beaches, Port Canaveral, KSC, dining, shopping, and all the best of the Space Coast. Whether you're looking for a full-time residence, coastal retreat, or investment opportunity, this is a rare chance to own waterfront living in the heart of Merritt Island.

MORE PICS TO COME! Welcome home to Merritt Towers! This 2-bed, 2-bath waterfront unit offers 1,269 square feet, split-bedrooms, assigned covered parking. Ground floor unit with direct outside access from patio!! Monthly dues include water, sewer, trash, wifi, cable, pest control, wonderful amenities and more! So close to the new Cape Canaveral Hospital, shopping, & Cocoa Beach right up the road!! Slider doors frame open to a screened patio with direct access to the waterfront lawn. Enjoy your morning coffee overlooking the water, then step right outside—no hallway or elevator needed. Inside, renovated guest bath, wood-look laminate and tile flooring, crown moulding, chair rail and updated kitchen with classic white cabinetry,striking black-and-white granite countersplash, new appliances, and breakfast bar. Gorgeous decorative lighting throughout the home. Assigned covered parking is right outside the unit. Enjoy the community's waterfront pool and a central Merritt Island location!!

Welcome to waterfront living at Merritt Towers! This furnished 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence is rare first-floor convenience with the feel of a single-family home and incredible Sykes Creek views. Step through the sliders onto the expansive screened lanai and watch dolphins, manatees and boats pass by, or walk directly from your back porch to the waterfront boardwalk. Freshly painted and move-in ready, the spacious interior features plantation shutters, upgraded bathrooms, a wet bar and generous storage. A covered carport is included. Merritt Towers is a gated waterfront community with two riverfront pools, hot tub, sauna, tennis and pickleball courts, shuffleboard, clubhouses, BBQ areas and a scenic boardwalk. Convenient to shopping, dining, the new hospital, Cocoa Beach and Port Canaveral. Enjoy morning coffee, wildlife and even rocket launches from the waterfront-Florida living at its best!
